title: OpenAIError
description: OpenAI's error envelope. A master answers an inference request's failure in it when the caller asked for OpenAI errors (a Bearer `lga_sk_` key, or the error-format header); otherwise the same failure is `{"detail": <message>}` with no code. `/messages` answers in Anthropic's envelope instead. Keys a master adds go BESIDE `error`, never inside it.

code.description: The relay's name for the failure.

NoProvidersAvailable.description: No provider serves the requested model now. Inside a master's boot hold (BOOT_HOLD_WINDOW_SECONDS after it starts) a request for a model nobody serves yet is held up to BOOT_HOLD_SECONDS first, so that a provider parked on the sleeping grid can come back.

RelayRestarting.description: The master holding the request ended it while retiring or stopping (Phase B 11): send it again. A stream gets it as its terminal event; a Responses stream as a `response.failed` event whose `response.error` is `{code, message}`. The public CLI must not parse it. On 2026-10-01 only grid-src branch `feat/grid-scale-phase-b` sends it.
